messages:
alex: quick follow-up from today's aggregation incident. creating a single thread for owners, timelines, and recurring-pattern notes.

maria: tl;dr of impact?

alex: between 01:05-01:45 UTC we dropped ~9% of spans for inference traces and saw aggregation lag up to 45m. ETL backlog grew because the aggregation worker hit memory pressure on a few large batches after a recent shape change to tracing payloads.

sam: what did we do to mitigate?

alex: actions taken: scaled aggregator pods x3, reverted the shape change (kyle rolled back at 01:35 UTC), and enabled an emergency fast-path to accept and store raw spans without full aggregation so downstream dashboards didn't stall.

kyle: I pushed the rollback and captured heap profiles. initial root cause: a new optional nested "user_meta" array surfaced unexpectedly and triggered huge temporary allocations in the aggregator. I'll open the schema-guard PR today.

natalie: is this a one-off?

alex: concerningly, this is the 2nd schema-related OOM in ~7 weeks. suggests we need stronger migration controls and a canary gate for shape changes.

maria: owners + provisional ETA:
- kyle: ingest preprocessor schema validation + unit tests 1: ETA 3 business days (PR incoming).
- maria: backfill & correctness checks for affected range 1: ETA: 48 hours after deploy.
- sam: add alert & runbook + synthetic malformed-schema test in CI 1: ETA 24 hours.
- natalie: migration checklist + canary gating plan 1: ETA 10 business days for rollout.

sam: alert I'll add: `rejected-span-rate > 3% for 10m` and a dashboard card for "aggregation lag". runbook will include steps to scale, flip fast-path, and rollback the migration. also adding a CI synthetic that replays malformed spans through the ingest path.

maria: backfill approach: after fix is deployed we'll run a staged reingest with `--parallel=3` and compare aggregation tallies before/after. expect ~4-8 hours for the window; will post progress updates.

kyle: fix note: plan to implement lightweight shape validation in preprocessor + a batch-size circuit-breaker. will emit `schema_reject_rate` metric and a pre-deploy canary check.

alex: long-term policy proposal: require a staged canary for any schema/migration affecting tracing/aggregation plus explicit signoff in migration docs.

natalie: I'll own the migration checklist and canary gating. drafting a checklist and draft policy by EOD Friday; full rollout target 2 weeks. will coordinate with product on freeze windows.

sam: pinging @eng-sre on capacity/cost for backfills and any autoscaler tuning.

obs-bot: scheduled reminder created: remediation check-in in 3 days (1790380000).

alex: concise action tracker:
- #1 kyle: schema validation + tests 1: owner=kyle 1: ETA=3 business days.
- #2 maria: staged backfill & validation 1: owner=maria 1: ETA=48h after merge.
- #3 sam: alert + runbook + synthetic test 1: owner=sam 1: ETA=24h.
- #4 natalie: migration checklist + canary rollouts 1: owner=natalie 1: ETA=10 business days.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

kyle: starting PR now, will @mention when ready for review.
maria: will post pre-backfill checklist here before running.
alex: add a dashboard card for rejected spans by reason and a realtime aggregation lag metric so product/CS can gauge impact.
sam: adding to list.
alex: will keep this thread as the single source for progress and close after the 3-day check-in if on track. :eyes:
